caption: The drawing consists of three detailed, grayscale renderings of a cast-iron fireplace or stove unit. On the left, the front view of the fireplace is shown, displaying a wide circular base with decorative feet, a rectangular central section with ornate floral/leaf patterns, and a prominent vent or opening for fire logs. There are horizontal bars inside the opening and decorative, vertical grill elements below them. At the top center of the front view, there is an inscription that reads "PAT. JUNE 9, 03 PITTSBURGH SUPPLY." To the right, a side view of the unit is provided, highlighting the rectangular side panel with an embossed, sunburst-style decorative element in its center, framed by a beveled border. On top, both views show a circular, ridged element suggesting the continuation of a chimney or exhaust structure. Below the side view, a single ornate cast-iron foot or support is shown separately, detailed with foliate decorative patterns. The background of the drawing is plain and a light beige color, and all the components are shaded in monochrome tones to suggest texture, volume, and decorative details.
title: Toy Stove
